title: Parametric helical coil spring (Vanilla Node.js (zero 3D dependencies, hand-written OBJ))
seed: Build a script from scratch in Vanilla Node.js (zero 3D dependencies, hand-written OBJ) that procedurally generates: Generate a coil spring as a tube mesh swept along a helical path (circling a central axis while rising steadily along it). Coil radius, tube (wire) radius, number of coils, total spring height, and path segment count must be CLI-configurable. Save to obj with deterministic seeding, CLI parameterization, and an independent post-save validation step.
